author: ruixen.ui
name: ruixen-menu-options
description: This RuixenMenuOptions component is a visually rich and user-friendly dropdown menu built using the ShadCN UI library and Lucide icons. It offers grouped actions like quick edits (rename, clone), organization options (move, pin, share), and settings, along with a clearly marked destructive action ("Delete Forever") styled in red for caution. The menu is neatly structured using submenus, separators, and keyboard shortcuts, making it ideal for applications requiring a compact, accessible action panel for managing items.
